agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario starts with cart offset x=-0.24 and negative pole angular rate omega=-0.22, pole upright. With sensor_noise 0, controller applies small positive force (~0.65N) but insufficient to arrest drift; cart velocity becomes increasingly negative (v=-1.34 at step 220, -1.38 at 223) and position exceeds track limit -2.4 at step 223 (x=-2.419). Counterfactual resetting initial x to 0 with identical other parameters stays in track for same 223 steps, confirming initial offset/velocity bias causes failure.
